info.syllabusName: Kỹ năng thực hành chuyên môn (Qualification Exam)
info.description:
This course is a capstone competency-based assessment designed to evaluate students’ practical readiness for entering the supply chain and logistics industry. It simulates real-world operational problem-solving under time-constrained conditions, focusing on the integration and application of core SCM knowledge acquired throughout the undergraduate program.
During a 120-minute written examination, students are required to analyze business scenarios, interpret data, identify process issues, propose solutions, and demonstrate reflective thinking and professional communication. The course emphasizes the ability to make decisions under practical constraints using concepts from logistics, procurement, operations, transportation, and performance evaluation.

This assessment is aligned with the program learning outcomes (PLOs) and serves as a final checkpoint to ensure that graduates possess the essential professional competencies, analytical thinking, and communication skills expected by the industry.
